title: Haoxiguan sync keyring v1
description: The six-field client keyring emitted by SyncKeyring.toJson and recovered from authenticated .hgr plaintext. Keys are independent 32-byte addressing and content keys. The current generation must name an existing contentKeys property; that relationship and actual key handling remain runtime checks.

vault.description: A nonempty vault identity; not necessarily a UUID. Runtime measures the 128-unit bound using Dart UTF-16 String.length.

contentKeys.description: Canonical decimal generation names from 1 through 1000000, without leading zeros or signs. The currentGeneration membership check remains at runtime.

key32.description: Exactly 32 bytes encoded as canonical standard padded Base64, including zero unused bits in the final non-padding character.
